mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the past month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2.5% does not correlate with tighter monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals a strengthening economy, boosting consumer confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, leading to increased wage pressures and inflation expectations, which in turn drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE decrease > 0.5% does not correlate with increased inflation expectations.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is negative, it signals a monetary policy-induced economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of high FEDFUNDS and negative GDPC1 growth does not correlate with negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past month signals increased economic activity, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase > 1% does not correlate with positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the past month signals a strengthening labor market, increasing consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increase > 200,000 does not correlate with positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: When real estate loans (RSAFS) grow by more than 5% over the past 3 months and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3% in the same period, it signals a robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 5% and UNRATE decrease > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of RSAFS growth and UNRATE decrease does not correlate with positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% over the past month signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, boosting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease > 0.25% does not correlate with positive returns.
